environment.fla_import: operator namespaces only; unchanged upstream operator and utility files

method.timing: Median of 3 trials; eager warmup=20ms rep=80ms; CUDA graph rep=80ms
method.validation: FP32 RMS .005; BF16 RMS .01 except GDN dg/dbeta .02 per upstream test_chunk; r2 .01 gate failure retained
method.scope: Operator only; no input projections, output projection, conv, optimizer, routing network or gate activation
method.komp: Full includes normalization, route history, kernel Gram solve, chunk coeff/scan; no host numerical checks
method.komp_core: Precomputed h,p,r; geometry and its gradients excluded; diagnostic only
method.gsa: Native chunk_gsa, chunk64 checkpoint2; includes two memory stages and slot softmax
method.gdn: Native chunk_gated_delta_rule, chunk64, fused QK normalization
method.states: FP32, nonzero initial states, returned final states with gradients
method.features: Shared raw q/k/v, FP32 gates; independent s/g leaves for GSA
method.precision: FP32 and BF16 inputs tested; KOMP internally FP32 with tf32x3 block dots/IEEE Gram, FLA native precision
method.equivalence: Different algorithms; equal storage is not a claim of equal capacity or task quality
